# Poster at CHI2026
{:.no_toc}

Published: {{page.date | date_to_long_string: "ordinal"}}
{: .date}

This week, I’ll be at [CHI2026](https://chi2026.acm.org), the _Association for Computing Machinery Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems_ (I think it’s clear why they abbreviate the conference name).

I’ll present a poster on the work we’ve been doing since I started [my PhD](/posts/started-phd): an online election platform. You can download the [accompanying paper (PDF, 2.3MB)](https://bodi-project.nl/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/chiea26-684-decidos.pdf) and I’ll see if I’m able to convert it to HTML for easier reading. For the time being, you can also find it in the [ACM library](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3772363.3798937) (DOI: 10.1145/3772363.3798937).

If you’re at CHI, too, [let me know](/#other-places)!
